newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 4c to 557c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 4c to 557c/kg.

text.p: The Australian eastern wool market indicator rose a further four cents to 557 cents a kg clean at sales in Goulburn and Adelaide on Tuesday, Wool International (WI) said.
In a firmer merino fleece market, 19 micron was one percent cheaper, 20/21m were up to 1.5 percent dearer, 22/23m were 0.5 percent dearer and 24/25/26m were 1.0 percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 27/30m were slightly dearer, 28/31m were 0.5 percent cheaper and 29m slightly cheaper.
In cardings, lambs were slightly cheaper and locks and crutchings were generally unchanged.
WI said local mills and Japanese and Chinese interests were principal buyers with support from Taiwan and most other sectors.
Of 21,550 bales offered in both centres, 7.1 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Goulburn, Adelaide and Fremantle, with about 39,000 bales to be offered.
